text: Hi, I'm Beth.
And I'm Neil,
and this is Real Easy English from BBC Learning English.
zh: 这里是BBC英语学习的《真实简单英语》。
zh_hant: 這裡是BBC英語學習的《真實簡單英語》。

text: In this podcast,
we talk about big topics in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 我们用简单的英语谈论大话题，帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 我們用簡單的英語談論大話題，幫助你學習。

text: You can find all the vocabulary from this episode
zh: 你可以找到本期节目的所有词汇，
zh_hant: 你可以找到本期節目的所有詞彙，

text: and read along on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 并在我们的网站bbclearningenglish.com上跟读。
zh_hant: 並在我們的網站bbclearningenglish.com上跟讀。

text: Hello, Neil.
How are you today?
Hi, Beth.
I'm fine, thank you.
How are you?
I'm good, thank you.
I have just got back from holiday and it was very hot.
zh: 我刚度假回来，那里非常热。
zh_hant: 我剛度假回來，那裡非常熱。

text: And today we're talking about the environment.
We'll talk about climate change and what we are trying to do to help.
zh: 我们会聊气候变化，以及我们正在努力做些什么来帮忙。
zh_hant: 我們會聊氣候變化，以及我們正在努力做些什麼來幫忙。

text: OK, Beth.
Can you explain the phrase climate change, please?
zh: 你能解释一下“气候变化”这个短语吗？
zh_hant: 你能解釋一下“氣候變化”這個短語嗎？

text: Yes.
So, climate change is what we call changes to the world's weather patterns.
zh: 那么，气候变化就是我们所说的世界天气模式的变化。
zh_hant: 那麼，氣候變化就是我們所說的世界天氣模式的變化。

text: So, for example,
the general temperature, rainfall, that kind of thing.
zh: 总体气温、降雨量之类的。
zh_hant: 總體氣溫、降雨量之類的。

text: And in particular,
with climate change, we mean changes to the weather
zh: 说到气候变化，我们指的是天气的变化，
zh_hant: 說到氣候變化，我們指的是天氣的變化，

text: that are caused by human activity.
zh: 这些变化是由人类活动造成的。
zh_hant: 這些變化是由人類活動造成的。

text: So, Beth, are you worried about climate change?
zh: 那么，贝丝，你担心气候变化吗？
zh_hant: 那麼，貝絲，你擔心氣候變化嗎？

text: Yes, definitely.
I do think that it's a big problem.
zh: 我确实认为这是个很大的问题。
zh_hant: 我確實認為這是個很大的問題。

text: The world is getting hotter,
or the weather is changing quite a lot.
zh: 或者说天气变化相当大。
zh_hant: 或者說天氣變化相當大。

text: I know that in a lot of countries at the moment,
in the winter, it's much hotter than it used to be.
And this affects people,
It affects animals and plants, all sorts of things.
zh: 影响着动物和植物，各种各样的东西。
zh_hant: 影響著動物和植物，各種各樣的東西。

text: And it's worrying for the future generations, isn't it?
zh: 这也让未来的世代担忧，不是吗？
zh_hant: 這也讓未來的世代擔憂，不是嗎？

text: So children and future grandchildren have to live in this world.
zh: 这样，子孙后代才能在这个世界上生活下去。
zh_hant: 這樣，子孫後代才能在這個世界上生活下去。

text: And what kind of world might it be?
zh: 那会是一个什么样的世界呢？
zh_hant: 那會是一個什麼樣的世界呢？

text: So, Neil, what do you try to do to help climate change?
zh: 那么，尼尔，你试着做些什么来帮助应对气候变化？
zh_hant: 那麼，尼爾，你試著做些什麼來幫助應對氣候變化？

text: Well, I ride my bike whenever I can.
I try not to make journeys
in the car that I don't really need to.
I use public transport when I can.
I also try not to fly,
but that's mainly, To be honest, because I don't like flying.
zh: 但老实说，这主要是因为我不喜欢坐飞机。
zh_hant: 但老實說，這主要是因為我不喜歡坐飛機。

text: How about you, Beth?
What do you do?
Well, I try to not eat too much meat.
I might have something like chicken or fish maybe once or twice a week,
zh: 我可能一周吃一两次鸡肉或鱼之类的，
zh_hant: 我可能一週吃一兩次雞肉或魚之類的，

text: because I know that animal consumption, so eating meat,
zh: 因为我知道动物消费，也就是吃肉，
zh_hant: 因為我知道動物消費，也就是吃肉，

text: does contribute to climate change.
Now, Beth, you told me you are getting solar panels.
zh: 贝丝，你跟我说过你要装太阳能板。
zh_hant: 貝絲，你跟我說過你要裝太陽能板。

text: Is that right?
I did, yeah.
So I think we're going to have 12 put on the top of our house,
zh: 我想我们会在房顶上装12块，
zh_hant: 我想我們會在房頂上裝12塊，

text: and that will bring our electricity
zh: 这样能降低我们的电费，
zh_hant: 這樣能降低我們的電費，

text: bill down, and it helps the environment because it's using
zh: 也有利于环境，因为它使用的是
zh_hant: 也有利於環境，因為它使用的是

text: energy from the sun.
So, yeah.
That's a nice eco-friendly plan you have.
zh: 你这个环保计划真不错。
zh_hant: 你這個環保計劃真不錯。

text: It is, yeah.
Neil, is there anything else that worries you about the environment?
zh: 尼尔，关于环境你还有什么别的担心吗？
zh_hant: 尼爾，關於環境你還有什麼別的擔心嗎？

text: Yes, I'm worried about pollution.
The air in cities is very dirty, and we live in London,
zh: 城市里的空气很脏，我们住在伦敦，
zh_hant: 城市裡的空氣很髒，我們住在倫敦，

text: and sadly some schools
are right next to busy roads,
and the children have to breathe polluted, dirty air,
zh: 孩子们不得不呼吸被污染的脏空气，
zh_hant: 孩子們不得不呼吸被汙染的髒空氣，

text: and it can be really bad for their health.
zh: 这对他们的健康非常有害。
zh_hant: 這對他們的健康非常有害。

text: It can cause problems with breathing.
So, Beth, is there anything else
about the environment that worries you?
zh: 关于环境的事让你担心吗？
zh_hant: 關於環境的事讓你擔心嗎？

text: Yeah.
So obviously, we all know that there's a lot of plastic
zh: 显然，我们都知道海洋里有大量的塑料，
zh_hant: 顯然，我們都知道海洋裡有大量的塑膠，

text: in the ocean and rubbish around us generally.
zh: 我们周围也到处是垃圾。
zh_hant: 我們周圍也到處是垃圾。

text: But with plastic, it's so hard to get rid of it.
It doesn't go away on its own unless you recycle it.
zh: 除非回收，否则它不会自行消失。
zh_hant: 除非回收，否則它不會自行消失。

text: And a lot of animals are getting
caught up in plastic fishing nets.
They're swallowing plastic.
So this is a really big problem.
zh: 所以这真是个很大的问题。
zh_hant: 所以這真是個很大的問題。

text: And do you recycle?
Do you use things more than once?
Yeah, so I try and reuse things if I can.
zh: 是的，我尽可能重复使用东西。
zh_hant: 是的，我儘可能重複使用東西。

text: And yeah, we recycle plastic, metal, cards.
zh: 而且我们会回收塑料、金属、纸板。
zh_hant: 而且我們會回收塑膠、金屬、紙板。

text: I have a reusable water bottle as well and a reusable coffee cup.
zh: 我也有一个可重复使用的水瓶和一个可重复使用的咖啡杯。
zh_hant: 我也有一個可重複使用的水瓶和一個可重複使用的咖啡杯。

text: Let's recap the vocabulary we learnt during the conversation.
zh: 我们来回顾一下对话中学到的词汇。
zh_hant: 我們來回顧一下對話中學到的詞彙。

text: We learnt climate change,
which is what we call the changes in the world's weather patterns
zh: 指的是世界天气模式的变化，
zh_hant: 指的是世界天氣模式的變化，

text: caused by human activity.
We heard eco-friendly,
an adjective we use to describe something that helps the environment.
zh: 一个用来形容对环境的益处的形容词。
zh_hant: 一個用來形容對環境的益處的形容詞。

text: Recycling: collecting rubbish to use again.
zh: 回收：收集垃圾再次使用。
zh_hant: 回收：收集垃圾再次使用。

text: Pollution: damage caused by harmful chemicals,
zh: 污染：有害化学物质造成的损害，
zh_hant: 汙染：有害化學物質造成的損害，

text: for example in the air.
And public transport:
travel by bus or train,
zh: 乘坐公交车或火车出行，
zh_hant: 乘坐公交車或火車出行，

text: for example, to be more eco-friendly.
And that's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 本期《真实简单英语》就到这里。
zh_hant: 本期《真實簡單英語》就到這裡。

text: Don't forget to listen to our other programmes to help you improve your English.
zh: 别忘了收听我们的其他节目，帮助你提高英语。
zh_hant: 別忘了收聽我們的其他節目，幫助你提高英語。

text: Visit bbclearningenglish.com.
Bye for now.
Goodbye.
